study: Exploratory grid detection, not complete waveform digitization

cohort.signal_processing: ADC-to-mV conversion only, original WFDB checksums and initial values checked

evaluation.thresholds: Validation only, calibrated again after removing the initial 2048-node cap

external.annotation_scope: Clean red-grid region above the waveforms of one physical color scan
external.method: Pixel-derived profile peaks and local intensity centers, visually reviewed against the original crop
external.uncertainty: Uncalibrated. No subpixel physical accuracy or clinical generalization claim
external.unannotated_images: Grayscale scan and phone photo, inference and qualitative inspection only
external.source_image_distribution: Original/modified external source images are excluded from the public repository and deliverable archive
external.qualitative_phone_review: The unannotated phone photo has visibly sparse and misplaced predictions. No numerical recall is assigned without complete reference labels

sampling_sensitivity.scope: Illustrative sensitivity, not an aggregate improvement estimate

software_checks.local_errors: Missing original tests/fixtures/raster-v021.npz in partial checkout. Original fixture preserved, full-checkout CI required

software_checks.docs: 21-page build passed. Full binary gallery validation delegated to full-checkout CI
software_checks.visual: Reviewed 16-scenario capture panel, synthetic prediction crops and physical image/reference overlays
